sentences.text: Learned counsel for the petitioners wants this Court to go through the materials available on record including the investigation and also wants this Court to hold mini trial at the stage of cognizance and quash the prosecution against all the accused persons which is not permissible in law.
In view of the above, this application is dismissed.
